title: Galderma to snap up California-based ZO Skin Health for USD 1.5 billion
summary: Swiss skincare group Galderma announced on Wednesday, October 14, that it has agreed to acquire California-based ZO Skin Health for an enterprise value of USD 1.5 billion (EUR 1.3 billion), strengthening its position in medical skincare. Galderma has signed an agreement to acquire 100% of the dermatological skincare company in an all-cash transaction from its shareholders, including funds managed by investment firm Blackstone and members of the Obagi family, the Swiss group said in a press... - Industry buzz
